# X and LinkedIn

![Profile headers and picture, a figure card, app screenshot posts, a quote card and a three-page carousel](../../assets/templates/templates-social.jpg)

- Profile picture: `doefin-icon-blue.png`. Headers: `x-header-1500x500.png` and `linkedin-cover-1128x191.png`, in `assets/social/`.
- Bio: "Markets for Bitcoin mining difficulty. For professional investors."
- Write posts the way Matteo does. The first line is the subject or the number. Then the figures and what they mean. The last line is the turn or the view.
- On X, one sentence per line. On LinkedIn, short paragraphs of one to three sentences.
- When a post needs a chart or more than a few paragraphs, write it as an article on the website. Then post the main number with the link.
- A post with a number uses the figure card: one number, its label, its date and its source. 1200 × 675 fits both X and LinkedIn.
- A post from the app uses the app screenshot template: the screen, a one-line headline and the capture date. Crop to the part that makes the point. Never show a gain or a return.
- A LinkedIn carousel has three to five portrait pages: the question, the arithmetic, then the source and the disclaimer.
- Posts about Doefin markets end with the disclaimer.
- The company account says "we". Matteo says "I".
- No emoji, no hashtags, no tagging people for reach.
